segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or extremely dry under-eye skin consistently report strong, lasting hydration and relief from winter flaking, though one reviewer found the cream too heavy and greasy for her liquid eyeliner to grip.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive eyes or under-eye skin report the cream is gentle and non-irritating; one reviewer, however, developed itching and irritation after about a week and cautions against use on sensitive under-eyes.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature or thinning under-eye skin, including one in her 50s who has used the cream for years, report it keeps the area hydrated and helps soften the look of fine lines, dark circles and puffiness.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly softened fine lines, plumper skin and a less puffy, brighter under-eye area with continued use, often crediting the vitamin C, caffeine and honey; effects on dark circles are inconsistent, with most seeing them less pronounced but a few reviewers, including one 34 weeks pregnant and one who names dark circles as her main concern, reporting no significant improvement.
concerns.dehydration: Nearly every reviewer describes the cream as strongly hydrating, keeping the under-eye area soft and plump even in cold, dry weather, including several with dry or extremely dry skin; no reviewer reports it failing to hydrate, though a couple describe a lingering greasy feel as their complaint rather than dryness.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the honey in the formula with boosting her skin's barrier and relieving dryness over the long term.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports the cream gave her milia (small bumps) under her eyes; another explicitly says she has not noticed any milia and does not find the rich formula clogging.

extraits.texte: I received a sample of this product and really liked it, so I bought the jar. After about a week of using this under my eyes in the morning, my skin is so itchy and irritated. Would not recommend to anyone with sensitive skin/ under eye area.
I LOVE Farmacy, but not this product. It gave my under eyes milia spots.

extraits.titre: Good for brightening but falls short on dark circles
extraits.texte: Rating: 3/5 This eye cream has a lot of potential but fell short for me in some areas. It did help reduce puffiness and brighten the under-eye area, which was noticeable and appreciated. However, I didn't see any significant improvement in my dark circles, which was my main concern. The texture is lightweight, and it feels soothing upon application, which is a plus. While I like the idea of the added vitamin C and caffeine, I'd recommend it more for hydration and puffiness than for tackling stubborn dark circles. Complimentary from farmacybeauty

This was gifted by farmacybeauty. I'm obsessed with this brand and their clean ingredients, so I was super excited to try the eye cream. I put it on, got distracted, and didn't rub it in all the way—but when I tell you I could actually feel it hydrating my under eyes, I mean it. Once I rubbed it in fully, my under eyes felt really hydrated and looked brighter. I have super dry skin, so anything that adds moisture is a win. Plus, no noticeable scent and the packaging is adorable.

Eye cream is what I need the most during the day and night time skincare routine. I have mature skin, especially around my eye area. This cream keeps my skin hydrated all day long. I love the creamy but easy to spread texture. It helps reduce my dark circle and puffiness, make my eyes look brighter. highly recommend! complimentary from farmacybeauty

This product was gifted by farmacy beauty. The eye cream is hydrating and revitalizing! It soaks in well and is not sticky. It has a thick, creamy formula but I have not noticed any milia since using it, so it does not seem to be clogging my skin at all. I have been looking more awake in the mornings since using this, and my makeup goes on so well over the eye cream!

This eye cream is a game-changer! It's rich and nourishing, perfect for my sensitive eyes. I've noticed a significant reduction in puffiness and dark circles. The formula is gentle and non-irritating, leaving my skin feeling soft and hydrated all day. Highly recommend! Gifted by Farmacy.
